blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: . Reinforcement learning post-training for language models relies on two reward designs: human preferences (RLHF, DPO) and binary verifiers (RLVR). Clinical question answering fits neither. Near-correct answers differ by a single substituted entity, and no executable check decides clinical correctness. We instantiate a soft verifier from a maintained controlled vocabulary: UMLS Concept Unique Identifier overlap (via scispaCy, set-level F1) gives a graded, externally specified reward computed without a model in the loop. We combine it inside GRPO with an entropy-normalised LLM judge, which covers the safety and evidence axes overlap cannot see, and a small consistency penalty on padding and repetition that keeps early-training samples scorable. This three-term composite improves over SFT on Phi-3-mini (3.8B) over MedQA by 2.9% on EM (0.700 vs 0.680) and 39% on Token-F1 (0.202 vs 0.145); on Llama-3.2-3B the corresponding gains are 14% on EM and 35% on Token-F1. We report Token-F1 as the primary metric because it credits partially-correct clinical content that EM discards at this open-generation scale. Main-table results are means over 3 seeds with standard deviations below 0.005. The method transfers to PubMedQA, where training on the PubMedQA train set with the same composite reward improves Token-F1 over SFT by 22% on Phi-3-mini and 17% on Llama-3.2-3B without retuning. A reward ablation on Phi-3, varying the judge–ontology split at a fixed consistency weight, attributes 3 EM points to the ontology term, the contribution that catches entity substitutions the judge cannot. Three negative findings constrain the design: DPO under random negatives underperforms SFT for strong-prior models but helps the weakest-prior one; PPO under a sparse neural reward diverges; GRPO with KL-in-loss collapses at 7B. The recipe is designed to transfer to any domain with a maintained controlled vocabulary, a generalisation we leave to future work.
blocks.zh: 。 。 。 。 语言模型强化后学习培训依赖于两种奖励设计:人类偏好(RLHF, DPO)和二进制验证(RLVR). 临床问题回答也不合适。 近正确答案因单个被替换的实体而异,没有可执行的检查决定临床正确性. 我们从一个有控制的词汇中 立即分析一个软的验证器: UMLS Conception Unique Identifer 重叠(通过 scispaCy, set-level F1)给出一个分级,外部指定的奖励,在循环中没有模型计算. GRPO内部与一个普通的 LLM 判官结合, 它覆盖安全和证据轴 重叠无法看到, 这三期复合材料比SFT在Phi-3-mini(3.8B)在MedQA上提高了2.9%,在EM上提高了2.9%(0.700对0.680),在Token-F1上提高了39%(0.202对0.145);在Llama-3.2-3B上,相应的收益在EM上提高了14%,在Token-F上提高了35%. 我们报告Token-F1是主要衡量标准,因为它能分辨出部分正确的临床内容,EM在这个开放的一代规模上抛弃. 主表结果指标准偏差低于0.005的3个以上种子. 方法转会至PubMedQA,在PubMedQA列车的编组训练中,同样复合奖励的Token-F1比SFT改进了22%的Phi-3-mini和17%的Llama-3.2-3B不进行再调整. 对Phi-3的奖励,使法官-肿瘤学在固定一致性权重下分裂,属性 3 EM 指向肿瘤学术语,捕获实体的贡献不能替代法官。 3个负面的发现制约了设计:随机负分下的DPO在强先模型的SFT表现不佳而帮助了最弱先入为主的一;PPO在微弱的神经奖励下存在分歧;GPRO在7B出现KL-in-loss倒闭. 食谱旨在向任何有被控制词汇域转移,我们留给未来工作的概括.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en: Naming the right drug class but the wrong specific compound is a clinical error. Cross-entropy loss does not see the difference. It assigns the same penalty to “consider an anticoagulant” as to “warfarin” when the answer is “heparin.”
blocks.zh: 命名正确的药物类 但错误的具体化合物是临床错误。 纵横相损不相见相. 在回答“肝素”时,它规定“考虑反凝血剂”与“华法林”相同的刑罚。 “

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning can reward correctness directly, but only when the reward signal measures correctness. The dominant designs do not fit clinical question answering. RLHF and DPO ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) rely on human-preference pairs; near-correct and correct clinical responses differ by a single substituted entity, and random-negative pairs do not capture that contrast ( Azar et al., 2024 ) . RLVR ( Lambert et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) replaces the reward model with a verifier, but no executable check decides whether “ceftriaxone” is the right empirical antibiotic for meningitis. Recent ontology-aware approaches ( Khatwani et al., 2025 ) use UMLS knowledge graph paths as rewards for diagnostic reasoning, but require graph traversal that is brittle on noisy generations.
blocks.zh: 强化学习可以直接奖励正确性,但只有在奖励信号衡量正确性时才能奖励. 主导设计不符合临床问答. RLHF和DPO(Rafailov等,2023年)依靠人类偏好配对;近正而正确的临床反应因单个被替代的实体而异,随机负配对不能捕捉到这种对比(Azar等,2024年). RLVR (Lambert等, 2024; Guo等, 2025) 将奖励模型替换为验证器,但没有可执行的检查决定"脑膜炎"是否为脑膜炎的正确经验性抗生素. 近期的肿瘤意识方法(Khatwani等,2025年)使用UMLS知识图路径作为诊断推理的奖励,但需要图向转动,对吵闹的几代人来说是微弱的.

blocks.en: We propose to instantiate the verifier from a maintained ontology, scored at the concept level rather than via graph traversal. Where RLVR uses an executable check that returns a binary pass, ours is a soft verifier: it returns graded overlap against an external vocabulary, which suits a domain where correctness is a matter of degree and no exact check exists. The Unified Medical Language System (UMLS) ( Bodenreider, 2004 ) assigns Concept Unique Identifiers (CUIs) that collapse synonymous strings (“heart attack,” “myocardial infarction,” “MI”) onto one identifier and keep clinically distinct entities (“heparin,” “warfarin”) apart. CUI overlap between a generated and a reference response gives a graded, machine-checkable, externally specified reward. We compute it via scispaCy ( Neumann et al., 2019 ) , pair it with an entropy-normalised LLM judge that covers safety and evidence axes overlap alone cannot capture, and run the composite reward inside GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们提议从一个维持的本体学中即时分析核查者,在概念层面得分,而不是通过图轨。 当RLVR使用可执行检查返回二进制通关时,我们的是软的校验器:它会将分级的重叠与外部词汇相匹配,这适合正确性是一个程度问题且不存在精确检查的域. 统一医疗语言系统(UMLS)(Bodenreider,2004年)将崩溃同义字符串(“心律攻击”、“心肌梗塞”、“MI”)的独特识别器划入一个识别器,并将临床上不同的实体(“肝素”、“华法林”)分开。 CUI在生成和参考回复之间重叠,给予分级,机器检查,外部指定的奖励. 我们通过剪刀来计算 Cy(Neumann等,2019年),与一个涵盖安全和证据轴重叠的肽常态LLM法官配对,无法单独捕获,并在GRPO内部运行复合奖励(Shao等,2024年).

blocks.en: On Phi-3-mini (3.8B) over MedQA ( Jin et al., 2021 ) , the composite reward improves over SFT by 2.9% on EM (0.700 vs 0.680) and 39% on Token-F1 (0.202 vs 0.145); on Llama-3.2-3B the gains are 14% EM and 35% Token-F1, with main-table means computed over three seeds and standard deviations under 0.005. We treat Token-F1 as the primary metric: on open-ended clinical generation, EM discards a response that names the right entity inside a longer answer, whereas Token-F1 credits the overlapping clinical content (§ 3 ). The method transfers to PubMedQA ( Jin et al., 2019 ) : under the same composite reward, GRPO improves Token-F1 over SFT by 22% on Phi-3-mini and 17% on Llama-3.2-3B without retuning the reward mixture. A reward ablation on Phi-3 attributes 3 EM points to the ontology term specifically: it catches entity substitutions (“penicillin G” for “ceftriaxone”) that the judge cannot distinguish from correct responses on fluency and evidence axes. Three negative findings constrain the design space.
blocks.zh: 在Phi-3-mini(3.8B)于MedQA(Jin等,2021年)上,综合奖励比SFT在EM(0.700对0.680)上提高了2.9%,在Token-F1(0.202对0.145)上提高了39%;在Llama-3.2-3B上,收益为14%EM和35%Token-F1,主表方式在0.005以下的3个种子和标准偏差上计算出. 我们把Token-F1作为首要的衡量标准:在开放式的临床生成上,EM抛弃了一个在更长的答案中命名正确实体的响应,而Token-F1则将重叠的临床内容归结(§3). 方法转会至PubMedQA(Jin等,2019年):在同一份复合奖励下,GRPO在Phi-3-mini上将Token-F1比SFT改进了22%,在Llama-3.2-3B上则改进了17%而未再调整奖励混合物. 对Phi-3属性的奖励 3 EM 具体指本体学术语:它捕捉到实体替代物(“ceftriaxone”用Penicillin G),即法官无法区分流利性和证据轴的正确反应。 三个负面的发现限制了设计空间.

blocks.en: Contributions. We instantiate a soft verifier from a curated ontology as a reward source for language-model RL, distinct from preference rewards, from binary RLVR checks, and from KG-path rewards ( Khatwani et al., 2025 ) that require graph traversal; we run UMLS CUI overlap inside GRPO with an ablation that isolates the ontology component as responsible for entity-level corrections; we validate across model families and seeds and transfer to a second QA benchmark.
blocks.zh: 捐款。 我们从一个被整理的本体学中即时地对语言模型RL进行验证,作为奖励来源,区别于优惠奖励、二进制RLVR检查以及KG-path奖励(Khatwani等,2025年),这些奖励需要图象转录;我们运行UMLS CUI重叠在GRPO内部,与分离的本体学部分负责实体一级的校正;我们验证模型家庭和种子,并转录到第二个QA基准.

blocks.en: 3. Experiments
blocks.zh: 3. 实验

blocks.en: 3.1. Setup

Datasets. MedQA (USMLE 4-options) ( Jin et al., 2021 ) , 12,723 questions (10,178 train / 1,272 dev / 1,273 test). PubMedQA ( Jin et al., 2019 ) for transfer evaluation. The 500 zero-shot outputs used for reward calibration (Appendix A ) are drawn from the training split and are disjoint from the 500 held-out test questions used in all reported results; α \alpha is never tuned on the evaluation set.
blocks.zh: 数据集. MeDQA(USMLE 4-选项) (Jin等,2021年),12,723个问题(10,178个列车 / 1,272个dev / 1,273个测试). PubMedQA (Jin等, 2019) 为转移评价. 用于奖励校正的500个零射出产出(附录A)取自于培训的分出,与所有报告结果中使用的500个被搁置测试问题脱节;α\α从不调取评价集.

blocks.en: Models. Three families with LoRA ( r = 8 r{=}8 , α = 32 \alpha{=}32 ): Phi-3-mini-4k ( Abdin et al., 2024 ) (3.8B), Qwen2.5-7B ( Yang et al., 2024 ) (7B), and Llama-3.2-3B ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) (3B).
blocks.zh: 模特儿们 3个有LORA的家庭(r=8 r{=}8,α=32 α{=}32):Phi-3-mini-4k. (Abdin等, 2024 (3.8B), Quen2.5-7B (Yang等, 2024 (7B),和Llama-3.2-3B) (Grattafiori等,2024) (3B).

blocks.en: Training. Single A100 80GB, 2,000 steps, AdamW. GRPO LR 10 − 5 10^{-5} (3B/3.8B), 5 × 10 − 7 5{\times}10^{-7} (7B). DPO β = 0.1 \beta{=}0.1 , LR 10 − 5 10^{-5} . SFT LR 2 × 10 − 5 2{\times}10^{-5} (3B/3.8B), 5 × 10 − 6 5{\times}10^{-6} (7B). Three seeds per (model, method): { 42,123,456 } \{42,123,456\} control LoRA initialisation and the order of training examples; hyperparameters are fixed across seeds. Results are reported as mean and standard deviation.

DPO baseline construction. We sample rejected responses uniformly from MedQA’s three incorrect options, the construction available from MCQ data without extra annotation. It is weakly contrastive: rejected responses are arbitrary wrong answers rather than near-miss confusables, which Azar et al. (2024) predicted would degrade DPO. We keep it as a baseline because it is the off-the-shelf preference-pair construction practitioners use; § 3.5 discusses the failure mode.
blocks.zh: DPO基线建设. 我们从MedQA的三个不正确的选项中, Azar等人(2024年)预测, 拒绝的答复是武断的错误答案, 我们把它作为基线,因为它是现成的偏好派建筑从业者使用的;§3.5讨论失败模式.

blocks.en: Multiple-choice to open-generation. We use MedQA’s questions but train and evaluate on open-ended responses (the gold answer text, not the letter). This stresses entity-level evaluation: answering “B” is irrelevant; answering “ceftriaxone” or a paraphrase is what we score.
blocks.zh: 多选取开元. 我们使用MedQA的问题, 这强调实体一级的评价:回答“B”是无关紧要的;回答“ceftriaxone”或解释是我们得分的。

blocks.en: Evaluation. Greedy decoding on 500 held-out MedQA test questions and 500 PubMedQA questions. Metrics: Exact Match (EM), Token F1, and Sequence Match (SeqM). We treat Token F1 as primary: EM scores a response zero unless it reproduces the gold answer verbatim, discarding answers that name the right entity inside a longer response. Because n = 500 n{=}500 is not a big value, we report a paired bootstrap 95% CI (10,000 resamples) and a McNemar test on the key EM deltas alongside the cross-seed σ \sigma .
blocks.zh: 评价。 贪婪地解码了500个被搁置的MedQA测试问题和500个PubMedQA问题. 量子:精确匹配 (EM),Token F1和序列匹配 (SeqM). 我们把Token F1当作主答:EM评分一个响应为零,除非它复制出金答逐字,丢弃在更长的响应中命名正确实体的答案. N = 500 n = 500 不是一个大值, 我们报告一个双靴子 95% CI (10,000 复标) 和 McNemar 测试 关键 EM deltas 与交叉种子 \\ sigma 并列 。

blocks.en: 3.2. Main results
blocks.zh: 3.2. 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1. MedQA test results (500 examples, greedy decoding). GRPO/SFT numbers are means over 3 seeds; standard deviations in subscript. DPO and Qwen2.5-7B SFT rows (no subscript) are single-seed runs. Bold = best per model per metric. Qwen2.5-7B GRPO collapsed across all configurations (§ 3.5 ).
blocks.zh: 页:1 1. MeDQA测试结果(500例,贪婪解码). GRPO/SFT编号指3个以上种子;下标为标准偏差. DPO和Qwen2.5-7B SFT行(无下标)为单种跑道. 粗体 = 每个模型每公尺最好。 Wen2.5-7B GRPO在所有配置中崩溃(§3.5.

blocks.en: Table 1 reports MedQA test performance. On Phi-3-mini, the composite reward (GRPO) yields EM 0.700 ± \pm 0.005, Token-F1 0.202 ± \pm 0.004, SeqM 0.238 ± \pm 0.005 over 3 seeds, beating SFT on all three. The EM gain is small in absolute terms (0.700 vs 0.680, + 2.9 % +2.9\% ; bootstrap 95% CI [ − 0.03 , 0.07 ] [-0.03,0.07] , McNemar p = 0.41 p{=}0.41 , n.s.); the Token-F1 gain is large (0.145 to 0.202, + 39 % +39\% ; CI [ 0.03 , 0.09 ] [0.03,0.09] ). The method moves correct clinical content into responses that EM still scores wrong for not matching the gold string verbatim, which is why we lead on Token-F1. The pattern reproduces on Llama-3.2-3B (+35% Token-F1, +14% EM). Cross-seed σ \sigma stays below 0.005 on every cell.
blocks.zh: 表1 报告 MedQA测试性能. 在Phi-3-mini上,复合奖励(GRPO)出产EM 0.700±\pm 0.005,托肯-F10.202±pm 0.004,SeqM 0238±pm 0.005出场3个种子,击败了SFT出场全部3个. EM增益在绝对值上是很小的(0.700对0.680,+2.9%+2.9\%;靴子夹95% CI [−0.03,0.07],McNemar p=0.41 p{=}0.41,n.s;Token-F1增益较大(0.145至0.202,+39%+39\%;CI [0.03,0.09]). 该方法将正确的临床内容移动到EM仍然因不匹配金弦逐字记录而评分出错的响应中,这也是我们领先Token-F1的原因. 该图案在Llama-3.2-3B(+35%Token-F1,+14%EM)上再现. 每个细胞的交叉种子都低于0.005。

blocks.en: Qwen2.5-7B GRPO collapsed across all configurations (§ 3.5 ); SFT on Qwen2.5-7B reaches EM 0.775, higher than any GRPO result here, as supervised fine-tuning directly amplifies its strong medical priors. We therefore scope the contribution to the sizes where GRPO is stable (3B–3.8B): at 7B, plain SFT on a stronger base is the better choice on EM and the ontology reward offers no benefit it can deliver.
blocks.zh: 文2.5-7B号 GRPO在所有配置上崩溃了(§ 3.5);Qwen2.5-7B上的SFT达到了EM 0.775,高于这里的任何GRPO结果,因为受监督的微调直接放大了它的强医学前科. 因此,我们对GRPO稳定的规模(3B–3.8B)有所贡献:在7B时,更强大的基础上的平地SFT是EM的更好选择,而本体学奖励并不能带来任何好处。

blocks.en: 3.3. Reward ablation
blocks.zh: 3.3. 报酬的减少

blocks.en: Table 2. Reward component ablation on Phi-3-mini, means over 3 seeds
blocks.zh: 页:1 2. 奖励部分在Phi-3-mini上减少,是指3个以上种子

blocks.en: Table 2 varies the two learned reward terms on Phi-3-mini, holding the consistency weight fixed at γ = 0.1 \gamma{=}0.1 throughout; each row is over the same 3 seeds as the main table. Judge-only settles at EM 0.667. UMLS-only is noisier early, since CUI extraction on incoherent generations returns empty sets and gives no gradient, but it converges to 0.592. The full mixture scores highest on every metric. The judge-to-composite gap is 3 EM points, in line with the calibration result (Appendix A ), where the composite tracks EM more closely than either term on its own. We do not lean on those 3 points in isolation: at n = 500 n{=}500 the paired test does not clear significance (McNemar p = 0.18 p{=}0.18 ).
3.4. Transfer to PubMedQA
blocks.zh: 3.4. 转让给PubMedQA

blocks.en: We train on the PubMedQA train set with the same composite reward, the same weights ( α = 0.6 \alpha{=}0.6 , β = 0.3 \beta{=}0.3 , γ = 0.1 \gamma{=}0.1 ), and the same prompt template as MedQA, and evaluate on 500 held-out PubMedQA test questions. Without retuning the reward mixture or the judge prompt, GRPO improves Token-F1 over SFT by 22% on Phi-3-mini (0.183 vs 0.150) and 17% on Llama-3.2-3B (0.142 vs 0.121). The transfer gain is smaller than the MedQA in-domain gain (39% / 35%) but consistently positive: the composite reward generalises beyond MedQA and is not a MedQA-specific artifact of the LLM judge prompt or the CUI overlap statistic.
blocks.zh: 我们搭乘PubMedQA列车进行同一套复合奖励,相同重量(α = 0.6\alpha{=}0.6,β = 0.3\beta{=}0.3,γ = 0.1\gamma{=}0.1),与MedQA相同的即时模板,评价500个被搁置的PubMedQA测试问题. GRPO没有重新调整奖励混合物或法官提示,在Phi-3-mini(0.183对0.150)和Llama-3.2-3B(0.142对0.121)上,Token-F1比SFT改进了22%. 转会费收益比MedQA的域内收益(39%/35%)要小,但始终是积极的:综合奖励概括到MedQA之外,不是LLM法官即时或CUI重叠统计的MedQA特有文物.

blocks.en: 3.5. Negative findings
blocks.zh: 3.5. 否定的调查结果

blocks.en: DPO under random negatives is prior-dependent. On Phi-3-mini, DPO reaches EM 0.600 (8 below SFT); on Qwen2.5-7B, 0.630 (14 below). In both, training loss crashes toward zero near step 400 (Phi-3: 0.066; Qwen: 0.030) then recovers to a plateau, the signature of early reward hacking followed by mode collapse. The cause: rejected responses are MedQA’s incorrect options sampled uniformly, so they are arbitrary wrong answers rather than near-miss confusables, and the contrast is weakly informative for a strong-prior model ( Azar et al., 2024 ) . On Llama-3.2-3B (weakest prior), DPO at 0.640 exceeds SFT at 0.570: the value of a random negative depends on the model’s baseline uncertainty.
blocks.zh: 随机负数下的DPO是前置依赖. 在Phi-3-mini上,DPO达到EM 0.600(SFT下8个);在Quen2.5-7B上,0.630(下14个). 在这两起事件中,训练损失坠入了近400步的零(Phi-3:0.066;Quen:0.030)后恢复到高地上,即早期奖励黑客的标志,随后模式崩溃. 原因:被否决的回答是 MedQA 的不正确的选项被统一抽取,所以它们是任意错误的答案,而不是近乎误入歧途的错失,而对于一个强优先模型来说,反之则资料不足(Azar等,2024年). 在Llama-3.2-3B上(最弱的前作),0.640分的DPO超过0.570分的SFT:随机负值的值取决于模型的基线不确定性.

blocks.en: PPO divergence under sparse neural rewards. PPO loss exceeded 28.9 by step 31 across all four configurations tried (LR ∈ { 10 − 5 , 5 × 10 − 6 } \in\{10^{-5},5{\times}10^{-6}\} , KL ∈ { 0.05 , 0.1 } \in\{0.05,0.1\} , max tokens ∈ { 64,128 } \in\{64,128\} ). The judge returns one scalar per sequence; PPO’s value network must split it into per-token advantages with no per-step signal to fit, and the resulting baseline is miscalibrated enough to run away. We report this for our setup (single-GPU, batch size 1, sequence-level reward), not PPO in general; GRPO sidesteps it via within-group normalisation.
blocks.zh: PPO的分数在很少的神经奖赏下。 PPO损失在所有四个尝试的配置(LR { 10- 5, 5- 10- 6}\in 10- 5}, 5 {时间} 10- 6 } , KL { 0.05, 0.1 }\\\ 0.05, 0.1 + ,最大标志 { 64, 128 }\\ in { 64, 128 })中都超过了28.9。 裁判员返回每个序列一个分级;PPO的价值网络必须将其分割成每个接地的优势,没有相接的分级信号,由此产生的基线被误判为跑出. 我们将此报告给我们的设置(单-GPU,批量尺寸1,序列级奖励),而不是一般的PPO;GPRO通过组内正常化来绕出.

blocks.en: GRPO KL-in-loss collapse on Qwen2.5-7B. Across all configurations (LR ∈ { 5 × 10 − 6 , 10 − 6 , 5 × 10 − 7 } \in\{5{\times}10^{-6},10^{-6},5{\times}10^{-7}\} , β KL ∈ { 0.01 , 0.05 } \beta_{\text{KL}}\in\{0.01,0.05\} ), Qwen2.5-7B GRPO collapses between steps 250 and 500. Tang and Munos (2025) prove the KL-in-loss formulation has zero expected gradient under the off-policy updates induced by single-GPU batch-size-1 training; our 7B result is an empirical instance, while the 3B and 3.8B runs do not collapse under identical settings.
blocks.zh: GRPO KL-in-loss-倒塌于Quen2.5-7B上. 在所有配置中(LR → 5 → 10 → 6, 10 → 6, 5 → 10 → 10 → 6), 10 → 6 → 5 → 10 → 6 → 5 → 10 → 6), 5 → 时 10 → 7 → 7 → 5 → 10 → 6 , β KL → { 0.01, 0.05 → ), Quen2.5-7 B GRPO 在250到500步之间倒塌. Tang and Munos (2025)证明KL-in-loss配方在由单GPU批量大小-1训练诱导的不政策更新下,预计梯度为零;我们的7B结果是一个经验性实例,而3B和3.8B运行在相同的环境下并不崩溃.

blocks.en: 4. Discussion and limitations
blocks.zh: 4. 讨论和限制

blocks.en: The contribution is the form of the reward signal, which does not depend on the specific ontology. A reward of the form “set-level overlap of canonical identifiers extracted from generated and reference text, against a maintained vocabulary” applies wherever such a vocabulary exists. Plausible near-term targets include legal QA via statute and case-citation identifiers and scientific writing via MeSH or ChEBI terms. We have not tested any of these; the cross-domain claim is a hypothesis we have not yet evaluated. The overlap reward is graded and computable without a model in the loop; we also conjecture it is harder to game by fluency alone than a learned reward, though we have not tested this.
blocks.zh: 贡献是奖励信号的形式,并不取决于具体的本体. 只要存在“从生成的和参考文本中提取的方言标识与保留词汇相重叠”的表格,就适用。 显而易见的近期目标包括通过法规和案例引用识别符提供的法律质量保证,以及通过MeSH或ChEBI术语提供科学写作. 我们没有测试过其中任何一种;跨领域的说法是我们尚未评估的一个假设。 重叠的奖励是分级的,在循环中没有模型可以计算;我们也猜想光靠流利的游戏比学得的奖励更难,尽管我们还没有测试过这一点.

blocks.en: Comparison to KG-path rewards. Khatwani et al. ( Khatwani et al., 2025 ) use UMLS knowledge graph traversal to score diagnostic reasoning. Our concept-overlap reward needs no traversal: it checks only that the right concepts appear, regardless of the path between them. This loses the reasoning-chain signal but gains robustness on the noisy generations that early-training policies produce, where graph paths are often unreachable.
blocks.zh: 与 KG- path 奖励的比较 。 Khatwani等 (英语). (Khatwani等,2025年)使用UMLS知识图转录来评分诊断推理. 我们的概念重叠奖励不需要曲折:它只检查正确的概念是否出现,无论它们之间的路径如何。 这失去了推理链的信号,但在早期培训政策产生的吵闹的几代人身上却获得了强大的活力,因为在那里,图道往往无法通达。

blocks.en: What the reward does not measure. Concept overlap counts entities, not the order they appear in or the inferential structure connecting them. A response that names every right entity in nonsensical order still scores well. This is why the LLM judge stays in the composite. The general pattern is to pair an ontology signal (structured, externally specified) with a model signal (reasoning, safety, evidence) so each catches what the other misses.
blocks.zh: 赏罚是不能衡量的。 概念重叠计算实体,而不是它们出现的顺序或连接它们的暗示结构。 以非感官顺序命名每个正确实体的回复仍然得分良好. 这就是为什么LLM法官 留在复合。 一般模式是将一个肿瘤信号(结构化的,外部指定的)与模型信号(合理性,安全性,证据)相配,这样每个信号都捕捉到对方错过的东西.

blocks.en: Limitations. Three seeds across two model families gives a useful initial signal but falls short of a definitive variance estimate; the modest test set ( n = 500 n{=}500 ) is why we report bootstrap intervals rather than relying on point estimates, and the EM gains in particular are small enough that significance should be checked before they are leaned on. The reward ablation is on Phi-3-mini only; cross-model replication of the ablation is deferred. The single-GPU constraint kept us below 8B parameters; the KL-in-loss collapse at 7B is real but does not predict behavior at larger scales ( Tang and Munos, 2025 ) , and where SFT on a stronger base already wins (Qwen2.5-7B, EM 0.775) the method offers no advantage. The MedQA-to-PubMedQA transfer holds the language and ontology constant; cross-ontology transfer (UMLS to MeSH or ChEBI) is the natural next test.
blocks.zh: 限制。 两个模范家庭的3个种子给出了一个有用的初始信号,但是没有得出明确的差异估计;适度的测试集(n = 500 n{=}500)是我们报告靴子间隔而不是依赖点估计的原因,尤其是EM增益很小,在调整前应该先检查其意义. 赏金还原只在Phi-3-mini上;跨型复制还原延期. 单-GPU的制约使我们一直低于8B参数;7B的KL-in-loss倒闭是真实的,但并不预测更大尺度的行为(Tang and Munos, 2025),而SFT在更强大的基础上已经获胜(Quen2.5-7B,EM 0.775),这种方法没有优势. MedQA对接PubMed QA转录持有语言和肿瘤常数;跨肿瘤转录(UMLS to MeSH或ChEBI)是自然的下个测试.

blocks.en: Appendix A Reward calibration
blocks.zh: 附录A 奖励校正

blocks.en: Before training, we measured Spearman ρ \rho between each reward component and binary EM on 500 held-out zero-shot outputs (from the training split, disjoint from test). On Phi-3-mini, ρ ⁡ ( R judge ) = 0.31 \rho(R_{\text{judge}})=0.31 , ρ ⁡ ( R CUI ) = 0.38 \rho(R_{\text{CUI}})=0.38 , ρ ⁡ ( R ) = 0.44 \rho(R)=0.44 for the composite at the chosen judge–CUI split ( α = 0.6 \alpha{=}0.6 , β = 0.3 \beta{=}0.3 , with γ = 0.1 \gamma{=}0.1 fixed); the composite is strictly more predictive than either learned component alone, and the ordering holds on Qwen2.5-7B and Llama-3.2-3B. scispaCy’s EntityLinker, on a labelled clinical sample, has precision 0.78 0.78 and recall 0.67 0.67 ; the calibration above already reflects that linker noise on model generations, which bounds the reward’s validity.
